opening.argument: The video shows a concrete fix for a common Netflix and YouTube playback issue on a Bush Smart TV. It directs viewers to change DTS TrueSound from On to Off, then try selecting content to see whether the issue is resolved. The visible settings menus show that change, making the central instruction an ordinary device-configuration step. The support website shown at the end is presented as a place to seek further assistance, not as a condition of the fix. Nothing in the supplied evidence describes a request for money, credentials, investment participation, or another financial action; nor does it establish what happens after a viewer visits the site.

citations.quote: we will show you how to resolve a common issue with Netflix and YouTube on Bush Smart TV
Scroll down the options until you have highlighted DTS TrueSound. Scroll right once to turn this option off.
Press the Menu button and try to select some content in Netflix or YouTube to see if this has resolved your issue.
